tagline.en: The farm-town road down the middle of the Changhua and Chianan plains, between Highway 1 and the coast, by way of Beigang's Mazu temple
tagline.zh: 纵贯彰化平原与嘉南平原中央的农业乡镇公路，介于台 1 线与海岸之间，途经北港妈祖庙

start.en: Central Changhua city, on Provincial Highway 1, in front of the Bagua Mountain archway and the county cultural affairs bureau
start.zh: 彰化县彰化市区，接台 1 线，八卦山牌坊、彰化县文化局前

end.en: Liujiading, Yongkang District, Tainan, back on Provincial Highway 1
end.zh: 台南市永康区六甲顶，接回台 1 线

en: Provincial Highway 19 runs 140.195 km from Changhua city to Yongkang on the edge of Tainan, starting and ending on Highway 1. It keeps to the middle of the plain, between Highway 1 and the inland cities to the east and the coastal Highway 17 to the west, through a line of farming towns: Xiushui, Puyan, Xihu, Pitou and Zhutang in Changhua; over the Zhuoshui River on the Ziqiang Bridge to Erlun, Lunbei, Baozhong, Yuanchang and Beigang in Yunlin; across the Beigang River to Liujiao, Puzi and Yizhu in Chiayi; and into Tainan by Yanshui, Xuejia, Jiali and Xigang.

A veteran highway planner, writing in 2017, described it as flat, on a wide formation and well suited to becoming a trunk road. Near its midpoint is Beigang and its Mazu temple, the Chaotian Temple. Its one spur, Highway 19A, runs 78.693 km from Yanshui to Chikan in Kaohsiung, the longest spur in the provincial system.
zh: 台 19 线自彰化市至台南市永康区，全长 140.195 公里，起讫点都在台 1 线上。它走在平原中央，东有台 1 线与内陆城市，西有沿海的台 17 线，串起一连串农业乡镇：彰化县的秀水、埔盐、溪湖、埤头、竹塘；经自强大桥跨越浊水溪，进入云林县二仑、仑背、褒忠、元长、北港；跨北港溪进入嘉义县六脚、朴子、义竹；再经盐水、学甲、佳里、西港进入台南。
公路规划者张浵在 2017 年的著作中称，这条路地形平坦、路基宽阔，极具开发为干线公路的条件。全线中点附近是北港，妈祖庙朝天宫就在这里。唯一的支线台 19 甲线自盐水至高雄赤崁，长 78.693 公里，是省道系统中里程最长的支线。

en: Between 1961 and 1971 the road's more important town sections were given a penetration-macadam surface. In 1976 the whole road was taken into the highways' six-year economic construction plan, to be widened to 18 m. The sections were finished at different times: Yanqiao to Puzi in April 1969, Puzi to Xuejia in December 1978, Xuejia to Tainan in January 1980, and Pitou to Lunbei, with the new 2,205 m Ziqiang Bridge over the Zhuoshui, in December 1980. The stretch from Citongjiao through Xihu to Pitou, an interchange link road for Freeway 1, was widened to 24 m, from Citongjiao to Xihu by 1999 and on to Pitou only in February 2002.

That last widening was a byword for delay. The Control Yuan censured the highways bureau on 13 December 2001 over the 2.9 km through Xihu and the rebuilding of the Ping'an Bridge. During the survey, begun in 1993, the bureau's own machinery crew resurfaced the road and buried centre stakes that had already been set out; by the time the first contract was let, in December 1996, the stakes had been lost again for want of upkeep, the contractor could not set out the work for half a year, and the contract was cancelled with compensation. Re-let in 2000, the job ran into boundary disputes with landowners and was 54 per cent done at the end of April 2001. From the first survey in 1993 to the planned finish at the end of 2001, the Control Yuan counted nine years.

In 1991 the bureau drew up an overall improvement plan to widen the whole road to 24 m, from the 1994 financial year over three years, but money ran short. It turned instead to a new crossing of the Beigang River, the Mazu Bridge, with 3.57 km of new road south of it, finished in December 2007; rebuilt a string of bridges — the Puzi River bridge in 2007, Housheng in 2010, Youche in 2011, Xincheng in 2014 and Taiping in 2015 — and the Ziqiang Bridge as a 2,224 m box-girder bridge in September 2004; and widened Pitou to the Ziqiang Bridge by December 2014. Bypasses have taken the road round Xihu, Pitou, Zhutang, Lunbei, Baozhong, Liujiao, Puzi, Yanshui and Jiali.
zh: 民国 50 年至 60 年间（1961—1971 年），先就部分重要乡镇路段加铺灌入式柏油路面。1976 年起全线纳入公路六年经建计划，按 18 米拓宽。各段完成时间不一：严桥至朴子段 1969 年 4 月完成，朴子至学甲段 1978 年 12 月，学甲至台南段 1980 年 1 月，埤头至仑背段连同新建的自强大桥（长 2,205 米）1980 年 12 月完成。莿桐脚经溪湖至埤头一段列入国道一号交流道连络道路计划，按 24 米拓宽，莿桐脚至溪湖段 1999 年完成，溪湖至埤头段则迟至 2002 年 2 月才完成。

最后这段拓宽是出了名的拖延。2001 年 12 月 13 日，监察院就溪湖境内约 2.9 公里的拓宽及平安桥改建工程纠正公路局。1993 年开始的测量作业期间，公路局自己的机械施工队铺设路面封层时，把已测设完成的中心桩埋没；到 1996 年 12 月第一次发包时，中心桩又因久未维护全部遗失，承包商半年无法放样施工，最终解约并获补偿。2000 年再次发包后，又遇上业主对用地界址的争议，至 2001 年 4 月底进度仅 54%。监察院指出，自 1993 年开始测量到预定 2001 年底完工，历时长达九年。

1991 年，公路局重拟台 19 线整体改善计划，规划全线按 24 米拓宽，自 1994 年度起分 3 年办理，却因经费不足而延误。其后改为先办理跨越北港溪的新北港大桥（后称妈祖大桥）及其南端 3.57 公里新辟道路，2007 年 12 月完工；并陆续改建朴子溪桥（2007 年）、厚生桥（2010 年）、油车桥（2011 年）、新城桥（2014 年）与太平桥（2015 年），2004 年 9 月将自强大桥改建为长 2,224 米的箱型梁桥，2014 年 12 月完成埤头至自强大桥段拓宽。沿线另以外环道绕过溪湖、埤头、竹塘、仑背、褒忠、六脚、朴子、盐水、佳里等市区。

en: The Mazu Bridge is described by its designer and its builder as the first single-tower extradosed bridge in Taiwan: two continuous 125 m spans of prestressed concrete over the deep channel of the Beigang River, with a 35 m tower shaped on the figure of Mazu and topped with her phoenix crown. The deck is 27 m wide, with two lanes and a slow lane each way and footways. The scheme runs 5,270 m from Wenren Road in Beigang to rejoin Highway 19 at Liudou in Liujiao, Chiayi; it was built between 15 April 2005 and 15 December 2007. It was designed as a bypass, to keep pilgrims apart from through traffic, and according to Chinese Wikipedia now forms part of County Road 145 rather than Highway 19.
zh: 设计单位林同棪工程顾问公司与承包商利德工程公司都称妈祖大桥为台湾第一座单塔型式脊背桥：主桥为两跨连续、各 125 米的预力混凝土梁，跨越北港溪深槽，桥塔高约 35 米，揣摩妈祖尊身神态，塔顶仿妈祖凤冠造型。桥面宽 27 米，双向各两快车道、一慢车道并设人行道。整个工程自北港镇文仁路起，南至嘉义县六脚乡六斗衔接台 19 线，全长 5,270 米，2005 年 4 月 15 日开工，2007 年 12 月 15 日竣工。它是以外环道的形式设计的，用来区隔进香车流与过境车流；据中文维基百科，今属县道 145 号而非台 19 线。

en: No cost for the road as a whole has been published. The Mazu Bridge scheme cost NT$1.13669 billion according to the highways directorate, of which NT$1.0491 billion was the construction contract, though a news report at the opening gave NT$1.475 billion for the same 5.27 km. It was built under the Yunlin and Chiayi living-sphere road programme, the two county governments entrusting the work to the directorate. The cancelled Xihu contract of 1996 cost the bureau NT$1,415,102 in compensation to the contractor.
zh: 这条路从未公布过全线造价。据公路总局资料，妈祖大桥工程总经费 11 亿 3,669 万元，其中发包工作费 10 亿 4,910 万元；但通车当天的新闻报道称同一段 5.27 公里的总工程费为 14 亿 7,500 万元。工程属「云林、嘉义生活圈道路系统建设计划」，由云林、嘉义两县政府委托公路总局统筹办理。1996 年溪湖段第一次发包解约后，公路局补偿承包商 141 万 5,102 元。

en: Traffic is heaviest in the pilgrimage season, from the lunar new year to the third lunar month, when pilgrims from all over Taiwan come to the Chaotian Temple in Beigang and to Xingang and Puzi nearby. Before the Mazu Bridge opened, Highway 19 and the old Beigang Bridge often came to a standstill in those months.
zh: 每年农历春节至三月的进香期是车流最大的时候，全台各地信众涌入北港朝天宫及邻近的新港、朴子。妈祖大桥通车之前，这段时间台 19 线与旧北港大桥常常交通瘫痪。

en: Limits are 40 to 70 km/h. The road crosses the east–west expressways at a run of interchanges — Highway 76 at Puyan, 78 at Yuanchang, 82 at Puzi and 84 at Xuejia — and Freeway 1 at Changhua and Freeway 8 at Anding. Through Yuanchang, lorries and container trucks must take the bypass built by the national construction agency rather than the main line through the town; at Beigang the Mazu Bridge bypass, and at Yizhu a straight road to the east of the town, take through traffic away from the winding main line.
zh: 速限为每小时 40 至 70 公里。沿线与东西向快速公路一连串交会：埔盐交流道接台 76 线，元长交流道接台 78 线，朴子交流道接台 82 线，学甲交流道接台 84 线；另在彰化接国道一号，在安定接国道八号。经过元长时，大型车与货柜车须改行内政部营建署兴建的外环道，不走市区主线；在北港可改走经妈祖大桥的外环道，在义竹可改走市区东侧的南北直线道路，避开曲折的主线。

why.en: No cost for the route as a whole has been published. Highway 19 is an old road surfaced and widened section by section from the 1960s onwards; only individual projects have published costs, listed below.
why.zh: 未公布全线造价。台 19 线是一条老路，自 1960 年代起分段铺面、拓宽，只有个别工程公布了经费，列于下方。

value.en: No breakdown for the whole road has been found. The Mazu Bridge was built under the Yunlin and Chiayi living-sphere road programme, with the two county governments entrusting the work to the Directorate General of Highways.
value.zh: 未查到全线的出资构成。妈祖大桥属「云林、嘉义生活圈道路系统建设计划」，由云、嘉两县政府委托公路总局统筹办理。

value.zh: 现长 140.195 公里；张浵书中记为 137.1 公里

timeline.en: The Yanqiao–Puzi section is widened, finished in April.
timeline.zh: 4 月，严桥至朴子段拓宽完成。

timeline.en: The whole road is taken into the six-year plan, to be widened to 18 m.
timeline.zh: 全线纳入公路六年经建计划，按 18 米拓宽。

timeline.en: Puzi to Xuejia is finished in December.
Xuejia to Tainan is finished in January; Pitou to Lunbei, with the Ziqiang Bridge over the Zhuoshui, in December.
timeline.zh: 1 月，学甲至台南段完成；12 月，埤头至仑背段连同浊水溪自强大桥完成。

timeline.en: An overall improvement plan proposes widening the whole road to 24 m.
timeline.zh: 重拟整体改善计划，规划全线按 24 米拓宽。

timeline.en: Citongjiao to Xihu is widened to 24 m.
timeline.zh: 莿桐脚至溪湖段按 24 米拓宽完成。

timeline.en: The Control Yuan censures the highways bureau on 13 December over the delayed widening through Xihu.
timeline.zh: 12 月 13 日，监察院就溪湖段拓宽工程延宕纠正公路局。

timeline.en: Xihu to Pitou is finished in February.
The Ziqiang Bridge is rebuilt as a box-girder bridge, finished in September.
timeline.zh: 9 月，自强大桥改建为箱型梁桥。

timeline.en: The road is moved onto the Lunbei bypass, announced on 14 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 14 日公告，仑背路段改道仑背外环道。

timeline.en: The Mazu Bridge over the Beigang River opens on 27 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 27 日，跨越北港溪的妈祖大桥通车。

timeline.en: The widening from Pitou to the Ziqiang Bridge is finished in December.
timeline.zh: 12 月，埤头至自强大桥段拓宽完成。
